title: The Potato Osmosis Test
description: Slice a raw potato, weigh it, soak half in salt water and half in fresh water for 15 minutes. Weigh both halves again.
trivia: Water always moves from low-salt to high-salt through a membrane.

title: Banana DNA Extraction
description: Mash half a banana with salt water, add dish soap, then rubbing alcohol. Watch white stringy DNA appear.
trivia: Bananas are triploid - every cell has 3 copies of its genome.

title: Yeast Respiration Race
description: Put yeast plus warm water plus sugar in a bottle with a balloon on top. Watch the balloon inflate.
trivia: Yeast is a fungus - same kingdom as mushrooms.

title: Leaf Pigment Chromatography
description: Rub a green leaf on paper, then dip the edge in alcohol. See colors separate.
trivia: Green leaves contain four pigments - fall reveals the hidden ones.

title: Onion Cell Under Microscope
description: Peel a thin layer of onion skin, place on a slide with a drop of iodine, look at it.
trivia: Onion cells have rigid square walls made of cellulose.

title: Fermentation in a Jar
description: Shred cabbage, add salt, press into a jar with water. Wait 3 days, then taste.
trivia: Lactobacillus bacteria turn sugar into lactic acid - same in yogurt.

title: Baking Soda Volcano
description: Mix baking soda and vinegar in a bottle with dish soap. Watch it erupt.
trivia: The eruption is CO2 gas - base plus acid neutralizing violently.

title: Invisible Ink with Lemon Juice
description: Write a secret message with lemon juice on paper. Dry it, then hold near a warm bulb.
trivia: Lemon juice oxidizes and browns when heated - same as toasting bread.

title: Density Tower
description: Layer honey, corn syrup, dish soap, water, and oil in a glass. Drop small objects and see where they stop.
trivia: Each layer has different density - a grape sinks to honey, a coin rests on syrup.

title: Elephant Toothpaste
description: Mix hydrogen peroxide, yeast, and dish soap in a bottle. A giant foam column shoots out.
trivia: Yeast acts as a catalyst, speeding up breakdown of hydrogen peroxide.

title: Milk Plastic
description: Heat milk, add vinegar, strain the curds, mold into a shape, let dry overnight.
trivia: Casein protein in milk reacts with acid to form plastic - old buttons were made of it.

title: Fire Without a Match
description: Touch fine steel wool to a 9V battery briefly. It catches fire.
trivia: Steel wool has huge surface area - oxygen reacts faster than heat can escape.

title: Coin and Paper Drop
description: Drop a flat paper and a coin from the same height. Then place the paper on top of the coin and drop again.
trivia: Air resistance makes paper float - on a coin, both hit the ground together.

title: Egg in a Bottle
description: Peel a boiled egg, place it on top of a bottle with a lit match inside. The egg gets sucked in.
trivia: Fire heats air which escapes; as it cools, atmospheric pressure pushes the egg in.

title: Static Balloon Hair
description: Rub a balloon on your hair and stick it to a wall. Watch your hair reach for it.
trivia: Electrons jump from hair to balloon - opposite charges attract.

title: Water Refraction Trick
description: Place a coin at the bottom of an empty bowl. Step back until you can barely see it. Pour water in slowly.
trivia: Water bends light - the coin you could not see is now visible.

title: Air Pressure Straw
description: Put a straw in water, seal the top with your finger, lift it out. Water stays inside.
trivia: Vacuum at top - atmospheric pressure holds the water column up.

title: Pendulum Wave
description: Tie several strings of different lengths to a rod, swing them together, and watch patterns emerge.
trivia: A pendulum period depends only on length, not mass.

title: Prove 0.999 equals 1
description: Let x = 0.999... Then 10x = 9.999... Subtract: 9x = 9. So x = 1.
trivia: 0.999... and 1 are literally the same number.

title: Fibonacci in a Pineapple
description: Count the spirals on a pineapple. You will find 8 in one direction and 13 in the other.
trivia: 8 and 13 are Fibonacci numbers - nature packs seeds efficiently with them.

title: The Four 4s Puzzle
description: Using exactly four 4s and any math operations, make every number from 1 to 20.
trivia: There is a solution for every number from 1 to 100.

title: Monty Hall Decision
description: Three doors, one prize. You pick one. Host opens another with nothing. Should you switch?
trivia: Always switch - 1/3 becomes 2/3 odds.

title: Birthday Paradox
description: In a room of 23 people, what is the chance two share a birthday?
trivia: 50.7% - probability tricks intuition.

title: The Infinite Hotel
description: A hotel with infinite rooms is full. A new guest arrives. Can you fit them in?
trivia: Move everyone from room N to room N+1 - Hilbert hotel shows infinity is strange.

title: Bridge Crossing Puzzle
description: Four people must cross a bridge at night. Two max, one flashlight, 17 minutes total.
trivia: Pair the two slowest together once - most people never think of it.

title: Einstein Riddle
description: Five houses, five colors, five pets. Who owns the fish?
trivia: Only 2% solve it without paper - everyone solves it with a grid.

title: The Two Doors
description: Two doors - one leads to treasure, one to danger. Two guards - one always lies, one tells truth. One question.
trivia: Ask: what would the other guard say - then take the other door.

title: The Poisoned Wine
description: A king has 1000 bottles, one poisoned. He has 10 prisoners and 24 hours. How does he find it?
trivia: Binary encoding - 10 prisoners can test 1024 bottles.

title: Three Light Switches
description: One bulb in another room, three switches here. You can enter the room only once.
trivia: Use heat - one on for 10 min, one briefly, one off.

title: The Wolf, Goat, Cabbage
description: Transport a wolf, goat, and cabbage across a river. Boat holds only you and one item.
trivia: Over 1100 years old - first appeared in Latin manuscripts.

title: Call Your Best Friend
description: Phone them and ask: Bie kokhon korbi? Then sit back and listen to the excuse.
trivia: 15 minutes daily with friends reduces loneliness by 30%.

title: Text Your Crush
description: Just one message. Not a paragraph. Maybe just a meme. See what happens.
trivia: Dopamine hits hardest on anticipation, not reward.

title: Ask Your Parents
description: Call them and ask: Tomader prothom prem kobe hoyechilo? Then listen without interrupting.
trivia: Most children know only 10% of parents life stories.

title: Message a Friend You Have Not Texted in a Year
description: Send them a photo or meme that reminds you of them. Just one message.
trivia: Highest-impact social action - receiver feels good for days.

title: Call Your Friend Mother
description: Yes, seriously. Ask her how she is doing. Watch what happens to your friendship in the next month.
trivia: Knowing your friend family is one of strongest predictors of long friendship.

title: Voice Note Marathon
description: Send a 3-minute voice note to someone telling them one honest thing you have never said.
trivia: Tone carries 38% of meaning - words themselves only 7%.

title: Write a 4-Line Poem
description: About the object nearest to you right now. No editing. Just write.
trivia: Poetry shrinks focus so tightly that mundane objects become metaphor.

title: Draw Your Hand Without Looking
description: Place your non-dominant hand on paper, draw it while staring only at the paper.
trivia: A Betty Edwards exercise - your brain knows what a hand looks like, so looking ruins the drawing.

title: Cover a Song in Your Head
description: Pick a song you love. Change its genre. Hum the new version for 2 minutes.
trivia: Your brain can remix faster than AI can generate.

title: Write a Letter to Your Future Self
description: Include 3 questions you want answered and 1 promise.
trivia: People who write to future self make more long-term decisions.

title: Design Your Dream Room in Words
description: Describe it as if a blind friend asked. Colors, textures, smells.
trivia: Writing descriptions activates same brain regions as seeing.

title: Take 20 Photos of One Object
description: Pick one thing in your room. Photograph it 20 different ways.
trivia: First 5 shots are obvious, next 15 surprise you.

title: Box Breathing
description: Inhale 4 seconds, hold 4, exhale 4, hold 4. Repeat for 3 minutes.
trivia: Navy SEALs use this to stay calm under fire.

title: 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding
description: Name 5 things you see, 4 you feel, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, 1 you taste.
trivia: Used in trauma therapy to pull brain out of loops.

title: Two-Minute Cold Shower
description: Turn it cold. Breathe. Stay for 2 minutes.
trivia: Cold showers raise dopamine by up to 250%.

title: Write Three Gratitudes
description: Three specific things. Not family, but the way my mother said good morning today.
trivia: 10 weeks of gratitude journaling gives 25% higher life satisfaction.

title: Ten Minutes of Silence
description: No music. No phone. Just sit with your thoughts.
trivia: Silence regenerates hippocampal cells for memory.

title: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
description: From toes up, tense each muscle group 5 seconds, release 10. Work up to your face.
trivia: Body cannot be tense when muscles are physically relaxed.
